# Fourth pass re-runs (generated by r7_fourth_pass.py)

1. Inductors as drawn: L201 220 uH, 50 turns, L203 470 uH, 64 turns on ETD39 N97 (gap for saturation
   >= 10 / >= 6 A): peak flux at the TCM peaks, the 3.0 A trips and a short; losses (tcm.py).
2. Output short and arc (M20 re-run) with the as-drawn output network: C1 = 100 uF (ESR 0.1) + 4.7 uF film,
   L2 68 uH, C2 4.7 uF, damping leg 22 uF + 1.0 ohm (+ 0.5 ohm ESR), R205 1.0 ohm / R212 2.2 ohm, W04 0.5 uH;
   the bridge as a switched source (420 V while the high side conducts, the low-side diode after the trip)
   into L1 from its 2.5 A peak; trip from the I_C discharge comparator after 1.0 us (fast front end: amplifier,
   100 ohm / 2.7 nF, LMV339, latch, DIS) or, if it failed, after one TCM period (low-side 3.0 A trip, 25 us)
   or the firmware (100 us). Faults: 50 mohm at the V_ANODE tab; a 30 V arc; V_ANODE short with the screen
   network discharging through R212 and D201 (1N5408).
3. Channel change, start-up and restart (M21 / M22 re-run) with the as-drawn network and the ADS7056 loop
   (r6 gains Kp 0.75, Ki 2000, Kc 2; Ts 25 us, Td 20 us: the slowest TCM case), TCM peak current.
4. Thermal on the plate: IGBTs on a 6 mm aluminium bar on the 2 mm plate, 1.5 mm Al2O3 washers.
5. Residue at the power amp with the as-drawn parts (r2 model) and the common-mode current into the chassis.

## 2. Output short and arc (M20 re-run, as drawn)

| Case | L1 peak (A) / B peak (T) | output resistor peak (A) / energy (J) | I_C shunt peak (A) / energy (J) |
|---|---|---|---|
| V_ANODE short, I_C trip 1.0 us | 4.2 / 0.15 | 378 / 8.24 | 211 / 0.311 |
| V_ANODE short, trip at the next low-side period (25 us) | 5.4 / 0.19 | 378 / 8.27 | 211 / 0.312 |
| V_ANODE short, no hardware trip: firmware at 100 us | 163.8 / 5.77 | 378 / 9.87 | 238 / 0.310 |
| V_ANODE 30 V arc 1 ms, I_C trip 1.0 us | 4.2 / 0.15 | 334 / 6.79 | 191 / 0.256 |
| V_SCREEN short, I_C trip 1.0 us | 2.9 / 0.17 | 173 / 8.91 | 132 / 0.145 |
| V_ANODE short: the screen network through R212 and D201 | — | R212 171 A / 8.83 J | D201 I^2t 4.01 A^2s (1N5408: 166 A^2s) |

Ratings: IKP08N65F5 ICpuls 24 A (no short-circuit rating, but the inductor keeps it out of a short); ULW5-1R0 about 19 J, ULW5-2R2 about 13 J short-pulse (M20); WSL2512 metal strip pulse rating to confirm (M20: 0.29 J). With the 220 uH inductor and the trip within about 1 us the bridge stops at under 5 A; even with no hardware trip until the firmware (100 us) the inductor stays below saturation only if C1 has not yet discharged: the table shows the peak (a double failure: the I_C trip and the low-side trip both missing). The energy into R205 rises against M20 (5.8-6.0 J) because C1 now dumps through 68 uH without the old 5.6 ohm path and the damping leg adds 22 uF.

## 3. Start-up and channel change (ADS7056 loop, slowest TCM timing)

| Case | V_tab tracking error max (V) | i_L1 average min / max (A) | TCM peak (A, capped at 2.5) |
|---|---|---|---|
| start-up 0 -> 400 V, 80 ms linear, tubes cold | 0.8 | -0.17 / 0.83 | 2.04 |
| channel change 400 -> 150 V in 100 ms, idle 0.3 A x (V/400)^1.5 | 0.4 | -0.26 / 0.30 | 0.98 |
| channel change 150 -> 400 V in 100 ms | 0.4 | 0.07 / 0.63 | 1.63 |

Restart with charged outputs: the TCM modulator starts at D = V_out / V_raw at the law's frequency, so the first periods carry the TCM ripple around zero (no -2.6 A reverse step as with duty 0, M22). Fail-safe: the link or the PWM generator stops -> the heartbeat monostable drops HV_ENABLE within about 20 us -> U504 disables both drivers at once (both IGBTs off, gates held by 10 kohm) and U508 sets the latch; the inductor current (<= 2.5 A, 0.7 mJ) finishes in the diodes (positive into the output, negative back to the raw rail); the outputs then fall through the tubes and bleeders (PS-3). PWM frozen with the heartbeat still running: open loop at the last duty, the output drifts to at most 0.985 x 420 = 414 V, under the 438 / 421 V trips. +12 V lost: UVLO per channel as before.

## 4. Thermal on the plate

Plate 85 C assumed (under the tube PSU, 70 C ambient; est.). R_th junction to plate = 2.2 (IGBT, datasheet) + 0.8 (1.5 mm Al2O3, greased, est.) + 1.0 (6 mm bar and plate spreading, est.) = 4.0 K/W.

| Point | Q_hs / Q_ls (W) | Tj high / low side (C) |
|---|---|---|
| 400 V 0.70 A (raw 420 V) | 1.08 / 0.10 | 89 / 85 |
| 400 V idle 0.30 A | 0.78 / 0.18 | 88 / 86 |
| 200 V 0.35 A | 2.10 / 1.43 | 93 / 91 |
| 200 V no load | 1.74 / 1.78 | 92 / 92 |
| 150 V 0.20 A | 1.71 / 1.47 | 92 / 91 |
| ramp-down 300 V -0.8 A (<= 1 s) | 0.89 / 2.16 | 89 / 94 |
| screen 390 V 0.18 A | 0.40 / 0.11 | 87 / 85 |
| screen 146 V 0.08 A | 0.62 / 0.57 | 87 / 87 |

Heat into the plate: about 1.7 W at 400 V / 0.7 A + 0.18 A (both bridges), at most about 4.5 W at 150-250 V (3.2-3.5 W in the anode bridge, 1.2 W in the screen bridge).

## 5. Residue and common-mode current

Residue at the power amp with the as-drawn parts (the r2 chain is the drawn one): V_ANODE 16.6 mV p-p at 400 V / 0.7 A (40 kHz), V_SCREEN 4.9 mV p-p, ESR 0.3 ohm; at the speaker <= 19 uV (KT88) / 32 uV (EL34) rms (r4). Low-side tab capacitance through 1.5 mm Al2O3: 7.5 pF -> 30 mA peaks at 4 V/ns (100-400 ns, each switching edge); the high-side tab is at the raw rail (DC). The current returns through the plate to the fault / RF network (100 nF Y2 || 100 ohm || GBU8J at the plated standoff H101) into GND_STAR.
